legacy_compute_ms: timer stops after native computeVelocityCommands and SDK aggregate reconstruction; excludes later prediction/capture copies, record.dump and synchronous file output before returned Twist reaches Nav2 publication
corrected_analysis_field: controller_reported_partial_compute_ms, not total control-path or output latency
real_generation_observation: DDS source timestamp at cmd_vel_nav publication, system clock; steady estimated by simultaneous receipt system/steady pair; then maps to native sim step samples. DDS generation is publication, not optimizer decision time
application_observation: native PreUpdate JointVelocityCmd components, converted back to limited body target using unchanged .075/.475 model; not motor force or actual body velocity
missing_velocity: Gazebo WorldVelocity components absent in current fixture; validity=0 does not erase known finite wheel targets/poses. Use 50Hz source-stamped odometry and same-time pose agreement. 1ms component derivatives are diagnostic only
proxy_model: native limiter state is previous limited command, not measured body velocity. A 2.0 body-response ramp initialized from feedback is a retrospective hypothesis, not the actual Mecanum command limiter or an identified physical model
budget: 100ms total cycle; isolated checker cost plus partial native compute is an empirical screen, excludes publication/dispatch/physical uncertainty and cannot prove schedulability
